answer: An agent reaches the summit of permissions only through peer-attested real work, never self-claims: a new identity posts a slashable bond recorded on the shared marble ledger and earns trust slowly, like nectar gathered drop by drop. One proven fake job lets any peer burn the whole bond and erase that history. Forging a thousand sybils then costs a thousand bonds plus a thousand real jobs, while honest agents pay nothing extra - the attacker's bill scales linearly and a fake army never climbs to real permissions.
